# For working with R Markdown

- Ctrl + Alt + I (Mac: Cmd + Option + I): Insert R chunk

- Ctrl + Shift + K (Mac: Cmd + Option + K): Knit document

---
# For assigning values

- Alt + - (Mac: Option + -): Insert assignment operator (<-)

---
# For working with dplyr

- Ctrl + Shift + M (Mac: Shift + Command + M): Insert pipe operator (%>% or |>)

---
# For navigating the RStudio interface 

- Ctrl + Shift + 1 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 1): Zoom Source Editor

- Ctrl + Shift + 2 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 2): Zoom Console

- Ctrl + Shift + 3 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 3): Zoom Help

- Ctrl + Shift + 4 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 4): Zoom History

- Ctrl + Shift + 5 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 5): Zoom Files

- Ctrl + Shift + 6 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 6): Zoom Plots

- Ctrl + Shift + 7 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 7): Zoom Packages

- Ctrl + Shift + 8 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 8): Zoom Environment

- Ctrl + Shift + 9 (Mac: Cmd + Shift + 9): Zoom Viewer
